g.text: Nerve desktop startup, supervision, and shutdown
Focus existing instance and quit this launch
Rename complete home to timestamped backup
Initialize current store and restore readable auth only
Configure loopback proxy bypass and tray
Create window and show loading page
Normalize URL and health-check with token
Initialize file-first storage, runtime, auth, and listeners
Supervise child and restart with backoff; owned = true
Fetch desktop settings with Bearer token
Clear service worker/cache storage for daemon origin
Welcome, recovery snapshot/replay, then live events
Report status only; never spawn or stop it
